persons.name: Maṇirāma
persons.evidence: maṇirāma śarmaṇā || iti bhāradjvāja maṇirāma viracitāyāṃ

date.as_written: samvat 1925 sāla miti kārtika vadi 5 roya 3

notes: The colophon records both the composition date of the commentary by Maṇirāma Śarman in chronogram (vedacandravasubhūmivatsare = [VS] 1814, Māgha śukla 5) and the copying date of this manuscript (VS 1925). The scribe remains anonymous ('likhitaṃ mayā').
